Welding Robot Operator

The company is looking for a Welding Robot Operator for the robotics department. In this role, you will be responsible for the automated welding process of high-quality stainless steel welded assemblies and will also perform various metalworking tasks. You will work in a production team with one or more welding robots, assessing and reworking products as needed. As a robot operator, you will monitor the functioning of the welding robots and the welding quality. The welds will be visually inspected, and any deviations will be monitored and discussed to ensure continuous process improvement. The plate thickness varies between 2 and 5 mm.
Team
There are different products: box frames, center arms, fences and grates, central units and boiler frames, collectors, M4use.
 What Will You Be Doing? 
▪ Operating and configuring the welding robot 
▪ Monitoring product quality 
▪ Improvement
What skills Do You need?
▪ You can weld in both Mig/Mag and Tig modes.
▪ Experience with welding robots.
▪ You are fluent in English.
▪ You are motivated and can work accurately.

What does the company offer?
    Salary between 20-21 euros gross/hour for 38 hours/week. With overtime (depending on client’s requirement): You can earn between 700-800 euros net/week (excluding housing and health insurance).
    Single Private Room in shared house
    Shared Company car or Travel allowance
    Weekly payment and long-term contract

AT The Family Business: 
    They have a close and friendly team where teamwork is key.
    They work with the best materials and state-of-the-art machinery in the safest and most organized work environment. They value order and cleanliness. 
    They manufacture high-quality products for special clients

About IQI

IQI Trusted Petfood Ingredients is a global supplier of high-quality ingredients to premium pet food producers. These ingredients are derived from natural byproducts of the food chain. IQI oversees the entire value chain and is recognized as a co-creator of trusted premium pet food ingredients. Partner driven, Exceptional, Rock solid and Exploring are the core values of IQI. It is part of the OSI group since 2023.

jobs.description:
About the Boerma Instituut

The Boerma Instituut was founded in 1980 by Theo and Jose Boerma and is currently led by Jacqueline Boerma, fourth generation of a family with more than 120 years of experience in floral design.

The school offers foundation courses, international programmes, workshops, masterclasses and the Master Florist programme (Meesterbinder). Our mission is to train students from all over the world to become professional florists and floral designers.

Position

As a Floral Design Instructor, you will teach classical and modern floral design, guide international students and represent the school abroad. The role includes teaching in the Netherlands as well as international travel.

Responsibilities

- Teach International Vocational, Advanced and Master Florist programmes, levels 1 to 3
- Teach hand-tied bouquet courses and floral courses for funerals, weddings and events
- Provide private lessons and group training
- Prepare lessons, order materials and create sample pieces
- Coach and mentor students
- Support competitions, events and open days
- Travel internationally to teach and demonstrate on behalf of the school

Requirements

- Master Florist Diploma (Meesterbinder) with transcript
- Average grade of 8 or international equivalent
- Transcript must be submitted
- Knowledge of the Golden Ratio, proportion, Fibonacci composition and asymmetrical floral design
- Teaching experience at Master Florist level is required
- Extensive portfolio of own work; the portfolio must be submitted before the interview
- Knowledge of colour theory and correct nomenclature of flowers, plants and materials
- Willingness to learn Dutch
- English is currently the working language
- Minimum of 10 years of professional floral design experience
- Minimum of 3 years of teaching or training experience
- Experience with international competitions and demonstrations
- Valid category B driving licence
- Strong artistic vision, technical skills, pedagogical skills and flexibility to travel internationally

Do you want to work as a chef in the Netherlands this summer?

You will work together in a team with other Spanish colleagues. From mise en place to preparing dishes during service.

De Basiliek is located in Middelburg, a historic city close to the sea. De Basiliek is a beloved spot in our city frequented by many locals as well as tourists. More hours may be worked in certain weeks as needed.

• the kitchen
• the toilet
• the bathroom
• the balcony

jobs.occupation: Order picker - night shift - English allowed!
jobs.description:
Are you a true night owl who performs best during the night? Do you already have some experience in order picking or logistics? Are you looking for a physically challenging role with job security? Then this could be the perfect job for you!

For a stable and growing transport company in Oostkamp that specializes in frozen food logistics, we're looking for an order picker to join the team in the freezer in the night shift. Do cold temperatures not scare you at all and do you speak English well? Then don't hesitate to apply, because the company is very welcoming to speakers of Dutch and English!

The job

As an order picker, you're the corner stone of the company's logistical processes. You work in the freezer every night to prepare orders for supermarkets throughout Europe.

Your responsibilites include:

• Making orders based on order lists
• Preparing completed orders for shipment
• Taking the orders to the loading docks for the trucks
You do all of this using an electrical pallet truck (also known as an "EPT").

Be sure to apply if you:

• Have experience in orderpicking or other warehouse work
• Aren't afraid of physically heavy work in a freezer environment
• Feel at your absolute best at night and are looking for a night job
• Have your own transport to the company (no public transport nearby)
Experience with an electric pallet truck (EPT) is a big plus, but not required.

!! Please note: you need to live in Belgium for this job. Actief cannot help you immigrate nor provide housing. If you don't have an official address in Belgium, you don't qualify and cannot apply !!

• The working language in the company is English, so Dutch is not required.
